description.narrative: Malawi, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Malawi (MOH)This program has the following goals: To contribute towards ending AIDS as a public health threat in Malawi by 2030. Reduce TB incidence to 102/100000 by 2027. Reduce TB mortality to 18/100,000 pop by 2027. The objectives of this program are: Reduce new HIV infections from 33000 in 2019 to 11000 by 2025. Reduce HIV and AIDS related mortality. Reach 95-95-95 treatment targets. Improve the quality of HIV services. Building resilient and social welfare systems for effectively respondingt to the HIV an AIDS epidemic. Increase TB treatment coverage for drug susceptible TB to 90% (2025). 99% of co-infected TB/HIV patients receive ART by end of 2027. The TB case notification through PPM increase to 25% by 2027
